name: SEBI registration certificate and renewal fee receipts
what: The PM certificate INP000007216 and the five-lakh fee receipt for each three-year block.

name: Books-and-records place intimation to SEBI
what: The letter telling SEBI where books are kept, with SEBI's acknowledgement.

name: Change-in-control / management change file
what: Prior-approval application, in-principle approval, NCLT papers, client notices and exit offers. Event-driven: if no change has occurred since registration, waived with that reason.

name: SEBI intimations of material change
what: Letters correcting particulars or announcing a change of Principal Officer, with dispatch dates.

name: Office infrastructure file
what: Lease or ownership papers, floor plan, equipment inventory, organisation chart and headcount.

name: Principal Officer and decision-maker qualification file
what: Degrees, CFA or NISM programme certificate, experience letters for the PO, the qualifying employee and each fund-management decision-maker.

name: NISM-Series-XXI-B certificates and decision-maker register
what: Certificates for the PO and each decision-maker, joining dates, renewals before expiry.

name: NISM-Series-XXI-A distributor certificates
what: Pass certificates for every associated person acting as PMS distributor. Waived with reason if the firm engages no distributors.

name: Compliance Officer designation letter
what: Partners' approval or appointment letter naming the Compliance Officer and the Master Circular responsibility.

name: Partners' meeting minutes and resolutions
what: Minutes approving policies, reviewing strategy and benchmark selection, receiving the internal audit report, authorising certifiers.

name: Compliance manual
what: The written policy on PM Regulations compliance: team roles, order placement and allocation, correspondence channel, due diligence, service standards, records retention.

name: Client funds and securities operations policy
what: Segregation, cash management in liquid funds, fiduciary conduct, no borrowing or lending, no speculation, no off-market transfers, permitted information flows, fair treatment, no scheme-like products.

name: Investment policy
what: Investment universe, the four Strategies, restricted list (no other PM's portfolios), own-research rule.

name: Dealing room policy and records
what: Dealing team constitution, authorised access list, device deposit register, IT and firewall restrictions.

name: Code of conduct and employee attestations
what: PIT code, Schedule III conduct, confidentiality, conflicts, proprietary trading, fair competition, UPSI undertakings, media-advice register and disclosure forms.

name: Cybersecurity policy and CSCRF self-assessment
what: Board-approved cyber policy, CSCRF roadmap, the self-assessment or status report submitted.

name: Order and allocation system documentation
what: Workflow documentation, allocation capture spec, alert configuration, audit-trail and time-stamp samples.

name: Accounting and back-office records
what: Client-wise accounting configuration and ledgers showing separate fund accounting.

name: Daily reconciliation statements
what: Signed daily client-wise funds vs bank reconciliations.

name: Client funds bank account
what: Bank confirmation letter and statement for the separate client-funds account with a scheduled commercial bank.

name: Custodian agreement and custody records
what: Executed custodian agreement, safekeeping records, holdings verification, demat statements in client names.

name: Disclosure Document
what: Current DD with Form C CA certificate, filing acknowledgement, website publication record, every revision filed within 7 working days.

name: Client agreement and annexure template
what: Current PMS agreement template: Schedule IV particulars, fees and charges annexure with illustrations, liability cap, conflict clause, consent form template, termination and renewal terms.

name: Client onboarding files
what: Per client: executed agreement, signed fees annexure with note of understanding, Annexure 3A consent, supplementary agreement, MITC acknowledgement, DD delivery acknowledgement, declaration of interests, onboarding-mode election, minimum-investment check, fee-tool link, amendments, renewals.

name: Client statements and reports
what: Monthly statements with dispatch logs, quarterly Annexure 5D reports, performance reports with XIRR, TWRR, benchmark and disclaimer, portfolio details on request.

name: Performance master and marketing materials
what: Version-controlled master performance figures, Investment Approach master and descriptions, marketing samples with approval and pre-clearance records, pre-investment disclosure pack.

name: Fees and charges records
what: Fee statements and calculation configuration, HWM policy, quarterly fee policy, no-upfront-fee evidence, rate comparison with associates, redemption exit-load sheets, direct-plan and direct-onboarding schedules.

name: Distributor file
what: APMI registration certificates, annual code-of-conduct self-certifications, trail-only remuneration agreements, payout ledgers, oversight reviews. Waived with reason if no distributors.

name: Related-party and associates register with consents
what: Register of related parties, client consents before related-party investments, off-market consents, breach and waiver logs, credit ratings on investment date.

name: Investment decision records
what: Rationale records signed by the PO, advice records, client instructions on corporate actions, entitlements records, rebalancing records, prudential-limit monitoring, RFQ confirmations, exigency deviation approvals.

name: Benchmark and strategy change register
what: Entries with justification, subscriber exit notices, annual audit verification of changes.

name: SEBI and APMI periodic filings
what: Monthly report with AUM, quarterly client data files, annual compliance report, APMI monthly report, each with acknowledgement.

name: Annual firm-level performance audit (APMI ToR)
what: Engagement letter, audit report, verification annex, SEBI submission and acknowledgement, compliance confirmation with certifier page and partners' authorisation.

name: Internal audit by practising CA or CS
what: Engagement letter and internal audit report.

name: Statutory audit and financial statements
what: Balance sheet, P&L, auditor's report, submission to SEBI with acknowledgement, audit certificate within six months.

name: Net worth certificate
what: CA certificate in the prescribed format, activity-wise where applicable.

name: Portfolio accounts audit by independent CA
what: Annual audit report on portfolio accounts, certificate delivered to clients, cooperation with client-appointed auditors.

name: Auditor deficiency rectification
what: Auditor's report under Regulation 30(2) and the action-taken log within two months.

name: Compliance Officer reports and attestations
what: Periodic compliance report to management, Master Circular self-assessment, remediation of SEBI observations, internal circulars, immediate non-compliance reports, prohibited-avenues certificate, periodic attestations.

name: Investor grievance file
what: Complaint register with dates, monthly website complaint disclosure (Annexure 7A), dispute resolution procedure, arbitration records, Investor Charter.

name: Client termination and withdrawal records
what: Statements of account on termination, settlement confirmations, premature withdrawal requests and trigger documents.

name: SEBI inspection and requisition file
what: Inspection access log, documents handed over, employee circular on assisting inspectors, Board requisitions and responses, regulation 37 investigation file. Waived with reason if never inspected.

name: Correspondence samples
what: Outbound letters to SEBI, exchanges and clients showing the registration number.
